news.title: AI驱动财富管理M&A新时代
news.snippet: InvestmentNew指出，人工智能正推动财富管理行业并购进入新纪元
news.raw_snippet: # AI Drives New Era of Wealth Management M&A, According to InvestmentNews. According to *InvestmentNews*, industry leaders believe the influence of AI on transaction activity will continue to grow as advisory firms seek greater efficiency and scalability. As *InvestmentNews* reports, merger and acquisition activity remains strong across the wealth management industry. Fidelity's April 2026 Wealth Management M&A Transaction Report showed that median deal size increased significantly, while private equity-backed buyers participated in most transactions. Derek Bruton, managing director and head of M&A at Modern Wealth Management, told *InvestmentNews* that technology and AI have become increasingly embedded throughout the acquisition process. He explained that advisory firms face mounting pressure to invest in infrastructure, data capabilities, and integrated client experiences, factors that continue to drive consolidation across the industry. Mike Wilson, chief executive officer and co-founder of Hamachi.ai, told *InvestmentNews* that AI is improving the experience for both buyers and sellers. According to *InvestmentNews*, these capabilities can streamline the transaction process and improve the quality of information available to prospective buyers.
